company.description: Ajaib is a financial super app that allows Indonesians to buy and sell stocks, ETFs, and mutual funds. The company is committed to opening the door to access investment instruments that are safe, trusted, and affordable. Its stock and mutual fund services can be accessed online, by all walks of life. The company was founded in 2019 and is headquartered in Jakarta,  Indonesia.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series C round raised $270,000,000, or 52.42% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $21,898,253 to $1,350,000,000, a 61.65x increase.
